What you receive

Creator shortlist

We do not start from a list of influencers. We start from your target audience, and look for the voices it actually listens to. Each voice is then ranked on three criteria: audience overlap, affinity with your category and risks attached to its name.

  • A ranked shortlist with audience overlap, affinity and risk flags.
  • Emerging creators before they become expensive.
  • The audience profile of each.
  • Format and platform recommendations.

How it runs

  1. Day 0Framing

    We define the target audience and the values to respect.

  2. Day 3Collection

    We find the voices speaking to that audience, beyond the usual lists.

  3. Day 7Analysis

    An analyst measures each one's overlap, affinity and risk.

  4. Day 10Decision

    We hand you a ranked shortlist, with our format recommendations.

Indicative timings for a first read; continuous monitoring starts as soon as framing is done.

Illustrative example

A luxury house targets Gen Z.

The biggest fashion accounts reach an audience it already has; three mid-size creators reach aspirational Gen Z with strong affinity for the house.

Our recommendationA programme with them rather than one big campaign.

  • Influence spend that reaches the right peopleYou pay for an audience that overlaps yours, not for followers.
  • Creators found earlyEmerging voices cost less before they become obvious.
  • Controversies avoidedRisk flags are checked before signing.

Frequently asked questions

Do you manage the relationship with creators?

No: we choose the right profiles with you, your agency or teams activate them.

Do you also measure influencer campaigns?

Yes, with the same method as any campaign: what it moved, and in whom.

Do you cover creators abroad?

Yes, in more than twenty languages, read by analysts who speak them.
